body: Added explicit fixture_state_queries array validation. If the field is present but malformed, validation records fixture_state_queries_not_an_array and processes it as an empty query set so the fixture coverage checks fail closed.

Added separate fail-closed regression tests for null or non-record receipts and malformed array fields. The focused rehearsal suite and adjacent post-attempt payload suites pass with the new coverage.

Added explicit source_artifacts array validation. If the field is present but malformed, validation records source_artifacts_not_an_array and processes it as empty so the input-artifact hash check fails closed.

Implemented explicit non-record receipt fail-closed handling. Missing, null, array, and other non-record receipts now return receipt_required with all checks failed and no property access on invalid input; regression coverage added.
